title: Relay Channel Messaging
audit_note: Core messaging implemented. RelayProvider context architecture completed (urm-ui013, urm-ui014, urm-ui015) - single shared WebSocket per session with persistent user identity via useCurrentUser/sessionStorage.

change_log.description: Adding RelayProvider context pattern - single shared WebSocket per session, persistent userId integrated with useCurrentUser

summary.goal: Replace the modal AI chat panel with a persistent channel-based messaging sidebar that integrates with agent-relay channels, supporting both broadcast channels (#planner, #plan-{id}) and direct messages to specific agents
summary.context: The current ChatPanel is a modal overlay for 1:1 conversations with 'AI Assistant'. The target architecture uses relay channels: #planner (global planning channel) and #plan-{id} (per-plan channels). Human users join as entityType: 'user'. A PlannerLead agent is always online when the backend runs, and can spawn specialist agents (DependencyAnalyzer, ScopeAdvisor, Reviewer) as needed. The UI should resemble Slack/relay-dashboard with a persistent right sidebar.
in_scope: Message input with @mentions for agent targeting
WebSocket connection to relay daemon via backend proxy
Presence indicators for agents in channels

acceptance_criteria.description: Messaging sidebar is persistent right panel (not modal)
Channel list shows #planner and #plan-{id} channels
Active channel messages stream in real-time via WebSocket

@mentions autocomplete shows available agents

Plan context (current step selection) shared with channel
Sidebar can be collapsed/expanded
Works in demo mode when relay unavailable (mock channel)
Single shared WebSocket connection per browser session (RelayProvider context)
User identity persisted via sessionStorage, integrated with useCurrentUser
userId passed to ws-proxy via query param for stable identity

component_structure.MessagingSidebar: Root container. Props: isExpanded, onToggle. Renders ChannelList, ChannelHeader, MessageStream, MessageInput based on state.
component_structure.ChannelList: Two sections: 'Global' (#planner) and 'Plan Channels' (#plan-*). Maps channels array to ChannelItem buttons.
component_structure.ChannelHeader: Shows #channel-name, presence count ('3 online'), avatar stack (max 5 avatars, +N overflow).
component_structure.MessageStream: Scrollable div with messages array. Uses ref for auto-scroll. Handles scroll-to-load-more on scroll top.
component_structure.MessageInput: Textarea + send button. @mention triggers popup. Disabled when disconnected.

state_management.RelayProvider: App-level context providing single shared WebSocket connection. Wraps entire app in main.tsx. Manages connection lifecycle, reconnection, and user identity.
state_management.useRelay: Hook to access shared connection from RelayProvider. Returns { connection, isConnected, userId, displayName }. Components use this instead of useRelayConnection directly.
state_management.useRelayConnection: (internal) Low-level hook used only by RelayProvider. Not called directly by components.
state_management.useChannels: Fetches channel list, tracks activeChannel, unreadCounts. Receives connection from useRelay().
state_management.useChannelMessages: Loads history via REST, appends from WebSocket. Receives connection from useRelay().
state_management.usePresence: Fetches presence via REST, updates from WebSocket join/leave events. Receives connection from useRelay().
